text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "Independent Complaints Authority for Radio and Television ICA", "gist": "ICA is the Independent Complaints Authority for Radio and Television"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Swiss Transportation Safety Investigation Board STSB", "gist": "STSB is the Swiss Transportation Safety Investigation Board"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The Independent Complaints Authority for Radio and Television (ICA) handles complaints relating to radio and television programmes by the SRG and private broadcasters.", "gist": "ICA handles complaints about radio and TV programmes from SRG and private broadcasters"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The ICA seeks to determine possible breaches of the law in editorial broadcasts or unlawful refusal of the right to appear on a programme.", "gist": "ICA investigates potential legal violations in broadcasts or denial of appearance rights"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "However, the ombudsman service must be contacted to review the matter first, before a formal complaint can be filed with the ICA.", "gist": "Ombudsman service must be contacted first before filing a formal complaint with ICA"}]}
